title: Chapter 6378: From Sin To Ashes

Chapter 6378: From Sin To Ashes

Chapter 6378: From Sin To Ashes

The blood lake returned to life; ripples became violent waves. The way they moved resembled lives attempting to climb out of the liquid.

Spectators became drenched in sweat, thinking about how the Chen offered their flesh and blood. They became one with the lake or rather, vengeful specters.

Waves of power traversed through time and emerged from the lake.

“Rumble!” The Chen’s territory starting from the peak to the city and all else was lifted in the air and destroyed. The lucky survivors exploded without a chance to scream.

A total of nine waves of power returned and transformed into tornados to suck up the blood, forming nine red pillars.

“What’s going on?” Crimson Virtue and the others were alarmed.

“Filthy rebirth.” Absolute Ancestor murmured.

“Boom!” after stabilization, nine bloody colossus appeared before the crowd. Each was stronger than Absolute Ancestor.

“The ten of us together shall be immortal!” Tenth-gen Chen bellowed and gathered the power of the Chen.

Fiery phenomena of the Chen’s sacrificed descendants appeared around him. Their life force, achievements, and power empowered him. It seemed as if they were coming back to life through him. They could see the world again and participate in the battle.

“So this is the legacy process?” A desolate god murmured.

Before this, the crowd assumed the process only included the main participants - the passer and the inheritor.

Now, all the sacrificed descendants could be seen. Tenth-gen Chen seemed to be a conduit for them to return to the world.

“The ten of us together shall be immortal!” They roared in unison.

The nine blood colossus turned into refined dao blood and entered Tenth-gen Chen’s body. A gigantic hole opened on his chest, looking like a black hole.

“Behold, the immortal shall devour the ages!” He shouted and the hole became a mouth biting at the sky. Stars were swallowed in the blink of an eye.

Even Absolute Ancestor thought this mouth could feast on her, let alone the others.

“Boom!” Its target was none other than the thirteenth peak.

Although the top masters saw this, they would just be throwing their lives away trying to stop it for they were mere shrimps before a whale.

“Destruction.” Li Qiye stated his supreme will and a palm descended again.

It pulverized the mouth upon contact. Nevertheless, the latter bellowed and tried to reshape.

Unfortunately, Li Qiye’s supreme will crushed it along with the visual phenomena around Tenth-gen Chen.

The nine colossus lost their form, turning into blood and raining down to the lake.

“Bam!” Tenth-gen Chen was immobilized.

“Nothing shall be left of you.” Li Qiye sent down a heavenly flame.

“Poof!” The whole lake ignited into fire.

“No!!!” Tenth-gen Chen could only watch the flame destroy the blood and the lake, leaving nothing behind.

“Zzz…” Screams from the blood could be heard during the burning process.
